authority_scope: Robustness Guardian, Advanced CSV, Alpha Synthesis, Microstructure Sensor Grid, Apex Council only

finalization_state.warning: RUN_PERSISTED proves the scheduled slot obtained a durable Git commit identity; it does not prove optional evidence work completed or found new evidence.

evidence_state.monotonic_guard: Never overwrite a lexicographically newer RUN_ID.
evidence_state.warning: Consumers must not infer substantive evidence from finalization_state alone.

heartbeat.purpose: recoverable mirror of canonical finalization identity

downstream_rules.apex_council: Bind sibling canonical finalization identities for durability/provenance, but consume substantive findings only from sibling evidence_state records whose RUN_ID is not newer than the bound finalization and whose EVIDENCE_STATUS is explicit.
downstream_rules.watchdog: May repair heartbeat/startup only; never create substantive evidence.
downstream_rules.scheduler: External authority; worker runs must never mutate scheduler state.
